steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Spot.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Spot, I'm here to return your comic.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Hmm, the door's not locked... Is he... out?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I'll put it back where it belongs!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: O-Oh no! Did I knock the bookshelf over?!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I gotta pick it back up...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: But all the comics are on the floor now... I don't know which one to put where... Is Spot gonna get mad?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Maybe I'll just put all the ones with the same titles in a pile together and wait till he's back.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Huh? How come this one doesn't have a title?
Popukar finds a leather bound book that stands out from the pile of comics. There is nothing but dust on its plain cover. No title, no art, not even a single word.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Which pile should I put this in?
Popukar flips open the book. The pages have slightly yellowed. There are comics inside, but they are all clearly hand-drawn rather than printed.
Although they aren't very professional, they aren't careless doodles, either.

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: My knee... My leg...

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: Bornu, can't you talk to your old man and get us an officer with better things to do than make us 'train' by crawling on the ground for an hour? As if that's fun?

steps.name: Youth
steps.text: I tried. No dice.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: This Bornu guy looks kinda like Spot!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I think I remember, Spot's real name is... Something... Bor...?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Bukar Bornu! Yep!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Oh, the line pokes out of the frame here...

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: At ease—Attention!

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: Look at the sorry shape you're in! Slacking off. Can't even stand straight! Our brothers on the front lines are spilling blood and sweat every day. What about you?

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: You've even got a man reading comics—

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: —Brigadier General Bornu!

steps.name: Father
steps.text: At ease.

steps.name: Father
steps.text: Who's reading comics?

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: Sir! It's Bukar Bornu!
Popukar turns the page, a wide shot covers the whole thing.
Bornu the soldier's hidden comics were all piled in the middle of the barracks.
The person who drew the comics in the book very carefully drew their covers, titles, and issue numbers. The strokes are all very heavy, so much that the pages are almost torn.
The people around him are crudely drawn in only a few strokes, to the point that they seem almost unreal.

steps.name: Father
steps.text: Brigade, kneel!

steps.name: Father
steps.text: Not you, Bornu.

steps.name: Father
steps.text: You are going to read every single word in these comic books. When you finish, that's when they can stand.

steps.name: Youth
steps.text: Brigadier General Bornu, sir. The books are mine. I should be the one to kneel...

steps.name: Father
steps.text: You'd best get started, or they will be kneeling until dawn.

steps.name: Father
steps.text: Even these books with their dreamed-up stories know that a man has to take responsibility for the mess he makes.

steps.name: Father
steps.text: You can't even do that, and you still read those superhero stories? You want to be a hero? You?

spans.text: You can't even do that, and you still read those superhero stories? You want to be a hero?

steps.text: By the time the young man is finished reading his books aloud, it has already been two hours.
Although some of the other soldiers sympathized with him at first, after two hours of kneeling, their eyes were filled with nothing but scorn.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Is it really so bad to read comics?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: No, Bornu's daddy—Spot's daddy's got it all wrong!
After that, the entire brigade was sent to the front lines.
Most believed the reason behind this decision was Bornu angering his father, and this made his situation all the worse.
In the end, Bornu chose to desert.
He was caught by the patrolmen before he could even leave the encampment. But, coincidentally, an enemy attack came at the exact same time.
The enemy's onslaught was swift and brutal. Before long, the already demoralized brigade was defeated.

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: There's nobody here. Let's split up and run.

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: Why the face? You gonna tell me you just remembered you've got a dad who's a general?

steps.name: Youth
steps.text: I hate him. He humiliated me, belittled me, and said I could never be a hero.

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: Then what are you waiting for?

steps.name: Youth
steps.text: I don't want everything to go his way.

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: What, you've got a fever? Got a concussion from all the explosions?

steps.name: Youth
steps.text: If I run, I'll be branded as a deserter forever. He'll never let me live it down, I'll spend the rest of my days in shame!

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: Yeah, and? You seriously want to be a hero? Save your own ass first!

steps.name: Youth
steps.text: I know I'm no hero.

steps.name: Youth
steps.text: But if I die, the miserable old man is going to regret what he said. Even if he doesn't, at least he won't have anything else to complain about. And if I survive this, I'll throw back in his face everything he's ever said to humiliate me!

steps.name: Youth
steps.text: If you wanna run, then run. This is my problem. Family business.

a.text: The young man knows that he doesn't have what it takes to fight this enemy. All he can do is gather the scattered remnants of his brigade.
Soon, the band of remnants grows into a squad of several dozen men.
Of course, the enemy has eyes on them, but the young man persists.
When they see the shield in his hand, more and more men start to gather at his side.
By the time they evacuate to the nearest allied encampment, there are two hundred men following him.

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: Bornu, come forward!

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: In recognition of your contribution to the last battle, you are hereby awarded the Hero's Medal, Class II!

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: Now, read out your citation!
The young man takes the citation from his superior, a heavy medal on his chest.
He suppresses his surging emotions and sweeps his eyes across the crowd below, only to find his father missing.
With equal parts regret and relief, he begins to read the citation.

steps.name: Youth
steps.text: This medal is hereby awarded on the order of...

steps.name: Youth
steps.text: Brigadier General Bornu.

steps.name: Youth
steps.text: Bornu...?!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: *sniff* *sniff*...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I knew it! I knew Spot and his daddy were going to make up!
Popukar rubs her eyes and flips to the next page to find it blank.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: That's it?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Popukar, what are you reading?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Eeep!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Sorry, Spot. I didn't mean to knock the bookshelf over...

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Eh, I know you didn't.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Wait, that thing you're reading...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I love this comic!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: You drew it yourself, didn't you? I never knew you were so talented, Spot!

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: I didn—

a.text: 'I didn't draw that, and that main character isn't me.'

steps.text: For some reason, Spot can't bring himself to finish the sentence.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Popukar, it's almost bedtime. Go find Orchid.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Yep! We have training tomorrow, and Orchid is throwing us a party afterwards!

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Oh, I forgot about that.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Spot, are you mad...?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Of course not. I don't even get mad at Midnight.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Now off you go.
Spot picks up the book and hesitates for a moment before turning around to sort through the pile of comics on the floor.

He knows his comics like the back of his hand, and just looking at the art on the back cover is enough to tell which issue of which series from which creator a book is. This will take no time to clean up.
After he puts everything back in place, Spot takes a look at the leather book again.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: No, I need to tell Popukar not to let anyone know what she just saw.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Hero? I've gave up on that a long time ago.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Hey, if I can at least be a hero to Popukar... to A6...

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: No way. I don't have what it takes.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Party! Party!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: That's right. It's a party.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (Sighs audibly)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You all did great in that second round of drills. Lucky you did, too, or I would've canceled our party.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hehe, I gave it everything I had to keep Instructor Dobermann from lecturing us for an hour.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Oh, did you now?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Uhh... Maybe seventy to eighty percent?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: If I may say so, all of us performed exceptionally well today.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Of course, if I had to name one man who gave the most exceptional performance, I reluctantly nominate myself!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Oh, what a cold response. I'm hurt.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Especially you, Spot. Do you really have no thoughts whatsoever on my perfect battle performance?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Sorry, something on my mind. Wasn't listening.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Oh, how cruel—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Okay, Midnight, shut up.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: (Shrugs elegantly)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Honestly, though, I think Spot did the best out of all of us today.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Yeah!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: He was acting kinda weird during the first drill, like he was trying to fight Instructor Dobermann. I was kinda worried...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: But not the second one! He healed me right when I needed it, and he helped me block Instructor Dobermann!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: That block was clutch.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I could tell right away the angle she was attacking from was iffy, but I didn't expect Spot to basically teleport right above her.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: If he hadn't been there at that exact moment, Instructor Dobermann would've come right for me after she took down Popukar. If that happened, we would've been done for.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Indeed!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Both Spot's heroic aura during the first round and his quick wits during the second round almost had me playing second fiddle—

spans.text: Both Spot's heroic aura during the first round and his quick wits during the second round

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Midnight, cut the bullshit.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Spot's... not in a good mood.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Popukar told you?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (Nods)

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Why... Why is everyone unhappy, all of a sudden?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Spot, was I not supposed to tell anyone about the comic—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Popukar, let's not talk about this right now, okay?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Ugh—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: So—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Right, the party! Orchid, is the canteen gonna be crowded today?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Don't worry. With our meticulous Orchid leading the way, no matter how crowded the place is, we'll definitely find seats. Isn't that right?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Sure...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Spot, don't be mad, okay...? I'm sorry...

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: I told you already. I'm not mad.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: It's just... There are some things I'm not sure I should talk about, and I haven't figured out how to talk about them.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Like—Hm...

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Midnight, say something.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Oh? My friend, you've finally turned to the deep well of knowledge that is my brain. The perfect place to seek inspiration.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Uh...

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Sorry, this is the first time I've ever heard a guy admit his brain's full of water.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: You see, Popukar? When I say 'I haven't figured out how to talk about this,' I mean I know how to say 'uh,' but not quite 'his brain's full of water.' Get it?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Anyway, I'll explain everything when we get to the canteen.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: So... I didn't do anything bad?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: No, you didn't.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: So, can I tell everyone what happened to you?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Popukar...

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: It's alright. Go ahead. If you do it, that's less I have to explain myself.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Wha?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Wow, Spot, I had no idea you were so badass!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Your brigade was routed, and you still gathered two hundred men in the aftermath?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: As much as it pains me to admit it, that is an achievement even I owe a standing ovation.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: But why did you get so gloomy when someone learned what you did? If I were you, I would be shouting my heroic deeds from the rooftops, to everyone far and wide, showing my medal to anyone who would look.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: I didn't get a medal.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: He didn't pin one on you? What an oversight—

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Because...
Spot picks up a dinner roll and takes a bite.
He figures that if he bites down hard, he'll gain the courage he needs here.
But he doesn't do it.
His jaws exert just as much force as usual. From chewing to swallowing, everything goes as smooth as could be.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Because I never gathered up any routed men.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: That night, when the enemy came, it didn't take long before I was alone.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: I took my chance and slipped out of their encirclement, and then...
Spot pauses for a moment to take a sip of juice, almost like it's intentional.
He's worried he might choke, but his mind is too occupied.
He once assumed he would keep this secret forever.
But, at this very moment, he realizes it would be more difficult to hide it from his friends, with whom he spends so much time.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: There was no going against my gut feeling, no gathering the remaining forces, and no award ceremony.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: I ran away. That's it.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: The whole damned army hated me. They expected me to run. And it's basically my personality. I was performing my strategic function.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: If I was gonna play hero, it would've spoiled the whole plot.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Spot, you don't have to talk about yourself like that.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Whatever.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: What of it, Orchid? You're thinking I didn't want Popukar to tell you guys because heroics like that aren't my style, right?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Yeah... pretty much.
A moment of silence passes.
Moments of silence like this are rare for Team A6.
Spots takes a look around.
Popukar seems a bit dejected; Midnight appears frivolous as ever; Orchid looks a bit tense, stirring her coffee repeatedly with a spoon; and Catapult sits restlessly as ever.
The one and only thing that's common to all of them is that they genuinely care about him.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: So... you drew the comic Popukar was talking about?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: That brigade was stupid. I listened to my old man and went out there to suffer. I had just about as much water in my brain as Midnight does now.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: The officers never saw footsoldiers as human. Every month, someone would collapse from overtraining, and in the end, we'd be shedding our blood in the pointless squabbles of the lords ameer.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: The hot climate was probably the only good thing about those years. The heat dried up all the water in my brain, and finally gave me a clear enough head to realize I should just desert.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: What if I didn't?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: For a long time, I couldn't shake the thought. And that's what gave birth to the self-glorifying doodle Popukar found.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: I drew it, even fantasizing like an idiot that if I didn't desert, my old man would've come around to see me in a new light.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Spot, let me go right to the point here. As well as I know you, I can say this: that's impossible.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Midnight!

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: It's fine. Let him talk.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Many moons ago, when I still dominated my line of work as the Devil of the Eastern Night, I once had an industrious coworker. He was known far and wide for his incisive way with words.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: We've barely gotten started, and I've already got a bad feeling about this.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: If you're gonna tell me your buddy joined the Higashinese military for some reason and couldn't fit in, well, I'm gonna be disappointed.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: (Laughs)

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: *sigh*.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: I can see right through your phony stories, but at least your heart's in the right place.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: If you end up being some great hero, I'll probably lose faith in the collective sanity of mankind.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: But if everybody comes to see me as a hero, I think I'll probably assume the species is just stupid.

spans.text: But if everybody comes to see
as a hero, I think I'll probably assume the species is just stupid.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: At the end of the day, my family raised me on an ideal that I just can't fit.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: That's why the comic ends with me getting a medal. It's the best my lousy imagination can conjure up anyway.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Even if I kept it going, once Bornu became a hero, I wouldn't know how to keep his heroics up. I can't plan it out, especially when it's an idea born out of a contradiction to begin with.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I think... I don't get it anymore... kinda...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: It's okay. It'll make sense after you grow up.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: But did I do something bad? Is that why you had to talk about stuff you don't want to talk about?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: No way.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Actually, it's all thanks to you, Popukar...

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: (Scratches head)

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: (Looks around)

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: (Clears throat awkwardly)

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Spot, are you sick?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: He's certainly not sick.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: But Spot looks like he's not feeling well...

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Words he hasn't spoken in his entire life are brewing in his mind right now. They're words so corny—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: —Are you sure about that, Midnight?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: —No, words of admiration. They are embarrassing to say to someone for the first time, you see.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Even I, cunning though I am, found myself terribly flustered when I hosted my first customer.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I'm right, aren't I, Spot?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: What do you say to a little one-on-one sparring tomorrow?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Haha, it'd be my pleasure.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Okay, let me finish what I was about to say—

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: —It's all thanks to Popukar that I realized...

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: (Quietly) ...It might just be easier to tell the people I trust most about my ridiculous 'heroics' than keeping them a secret.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I see. So Spot is saying we're the ones he trusts the most.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Spot, if you want to sock him, I'm willing to look the other way.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Orchid—

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Whatever.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Him spelling it out is as stomach-churning as ever, but seeing as he's not wrong... Whatever.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: That's more like it.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Alright, I propose a toast to Spot for the story he told us today. Na zdrowie!

steps.name: Team A6 Members
steps.text: Cheers!

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Alright, enough about my fake hero story—

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: But you are a hero!

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: You blocked Instructor Dobermann for me and protected everyone. You're why we're having this party now. You're a hero!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I'm going to hold a medal ceremony for you!

steps.name: Team A6 Members
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: We're all gonna be at the ceremony. Me, Orchid, Catapult, Midnight...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Hmm... That's not enough!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Let me think—Um, Bubble!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Say, Popukar?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: And Shamare, Suzuran...

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Orchid, Catapult, help me out here. I've got a feeling we have a tough fight on our hands.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: What about me, then?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: I'm thinking of telling the kitchen you're the one who talked her into this idea.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: You're welcome to go back to the dorm and mourn your paycheck, though.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Who is it?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: It's me. I have something for you.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Here. A 'hero certificate' from Popukar.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: A what?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Didn't we spend hours talking Popukar out of the silly ceremony idea?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: That we did, but she had a new idea when she got back to her room. No one could stop her this time.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: In any case, here's her hand-drawn hero certificate. For you.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: And you should know she asked all of us to sign it.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: And you did?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Naturally.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Yours is the only signature we need now. As soon as you sign it, your appointment as Team A6's hero will be unanimous.
Spot doesn't answer him.
He holds in his hands the 'hero certificate.' On it are the most congratulatory of words that Popukar could muster, adorned with a bunch of childish-looking art and decorative borders.
Spot reads the citation text once. Then, he finds his four teammates' signatures at the bottom of the awfully heavy-feeling sheet of paper.
It warms his heart.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: What's wrong? Do you need me to lend you an exquisite fountain pen to add the appropriate gravitas to your outstanding signature?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: No thanks.
Spot doesn't sign the certificate. Instead, he takes out an elegant photo frame and puts the 'hero certificate' inside.
Then, he puts the frame on the most conspicuous part of his nightstand.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Now that won't do, Spot. Popukar will make a huge fuss if you don't sign it.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: You aren't worried about Popukar. You're just worried Orchid will come complaining if Popukar makes a fuss about it.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Excellent insight!

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: I don't need your accolades. I'm not signing this.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: This is who I am, this is the life for me. I'm no hero.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: What? Not gonna say anything?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I'm simply overwhelmed that I finally managed to melt that ice-cold heart of yours with my earnest feelings—

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Midnight, I've had a sudden change of heart. Maybe it's not so hard to be a hero.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: The next time I go on a mission with you, I'll make sure there's a bad-tempered girl there for you to flirt with.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: You'll get your ass whooped so bad, you'll end up in Medical for weeks. Then, I'll really be A6's hero.
The two share a laugh.
